name: Sainted Swellback
description: Sets the feet on two parallel tracks and holds the guard so either line can open.

name: Gallant Carve
description: Cuts down the left track with the swollen belly of the blade into the shoulder line.

name: Cantlebanner
description: Returns on the right track along a flatter arc that reaches the hip.

name: Palllip
description: Swaps tracks in the middle of a parry so the foe's cut meets the guard from the wrong side.

name: Squall Deepbelly
description: Draws two linked slashes along the tracks with qi held between them.

name: Titan Flowedge
description: Hooks the foe's arm and pulls it across the second track to open the ribs.

name: Inferno Flaretip
description: Presses a cut down the first track and lets the second land before the guard resets.

name: Paramount Whipcut
description: Flings two crescents of qi from the blade along both tracks at a distant foe.

name: Statute Scimhilt
description: Raises both tracks as guarding lines of qi that turn aside spears and cuts alike.

name: Radiance Lop
description: Folds both tracks into a single flash and cuts from the side the foe did not guard.

name: Volition Talwar
description: Runs the school's two tracks as one unbroken series of cuts that the student paces to their strength.

name: Bedrock Crescent
description: Perches the blade high and angled like a folded wing over the lead shoulder.

name: Deluge Scoop
description: Folds the body and steps back so the foe's reach falls short by a hand.

name: Thunderclap Cantle
description: Dives from the high shoulder into a downward cut on the foe's lead arm.

name: Revered Broadcurve
description: Beats the foe's blade aside with the flat of the curve and keeps the dive line open.

name: Carveedict
description: Rakes the hooked point across the foe's forearm in a short talon strike.

name: Statute Saddleguard
description: Rises through the guard in an updraft that lifts and opens the foe's weapon.

name: Lordly Swellback
description: Ends a diving cut with a sweeping tail that clips every foe near the landing.

name: Squall Talwar
description: Glides the blade like a wing along the foe's attack and turns it harmlessly aside.

name: Seasoncantle
description: Drops in a flash from outside the foe's reach and lands the dive cut without warning.

name: Fearless Rake Crown
description: Dives along the full curve of the blade in the school's signature stoop that pierces a guard.

name: Sovereign Flowedge
description: Stands at the middle of the court with the blade low and both flanks covered.

name: Carvetriumph
description: Cuts high and heavy like a full basin spilling over the foe's guard.

name: Deluge Arcwheel
description: Paces in short wet-footed steps that keep the stance level on slick ground.

name: Faithful Scimhilt
description: Channels a cut off the blade like water running down a spillway.

name: Talwarpledge
description: Dams the foe's blade with the spine and presses it back before it can swing.

name: Vigor Lop
description: Draws the edge up through the foe in a slow rising stroke that gathers qi as it goes.

name: Deepbelly Triumph
description: Turns a foe's rush into a flood of returning cuts that fill the gaps in their guard.

name: Carveseal
description: Hooks across the whole width of the court and drags the foe back to the center.

name: Broadcurve Banner
description: Pours cuts from both sides until the whole space is full of edges.

name: Bedrock Saddleguard
description: Holds a stillness of qi around the body as a pool that blows sink into and lose force.

name: Unbending Carve
description: Lets the held qi spill beyond the guard and press the foe's weapon arm to the ground.

name: Unrivaled Crescent Banner
description: Builds a cut in slow strokes until it overflows the court and strikes every foe within it at once.

name: Immaculate Swellback
description: Stands with weight divided between both feet and the blade centered like a balance.

name: Vigortalwar
description: Cuts the first court's diagonal from high left to low right in one pull.

name: Noble Whipcut
description: Answers the first with the second court's cut from the opposite side.

name: Deluge Flaretip
description: Parries in the first court and returns in the second without lifting the blade between.

name: Inferno Cantle
description: Gives the cut two pulses of qi a breath apart so the second lands on the wound of the first.

name: Scoop Covenant
description: Hooks the foe's weapon and pulls it across to the second court's line.

name: Saddleguard Heraldry
description: Reverses the stance in a doubled step so that the second court faces the foe.

name: Flaretip Triumph
description: Drives the two courts' strokes through the same gap and punches the second through the first.

name: Prism Flowedge
description: Interlaces two guards of qi into a barrier that holds against a hard rush.

name: Famed Talwar
description: Closes both courts on one point so the cut strikes inward past the guard's armour.

name: Volition Scoop
description: Closes the school's course with a pair of curves that the student scales to their strength.

name: Deepbelly Troth
description: Stands as if on the river's bank with the blade low and the field settled around the feet.

name: Haemalscoop
description: Cuts a long even stroke that carries the weight of the whole body through the foe.

name: Lop Heraldry
description: Skirts the foe's flank along an imagined bank to find the open side.

name: Lipvow
description: Turns a cut in a small eddy of the field and sends it wide of the body.

name: Loptriumph
description: Draws the edge up like a river rising and cuts the foe from hip to chest.

name: Millstone Arcwheel
description: Hooks the foe's ankle and drags it back like an undertow pulling at the footing.

name: Fearless Arcwheel
description: Spreads the cut outward like a river leaving its banks to threaten every foe nearby.

name: Steellip
description: Spreads the field wide and keeps it flowing across the front like a river.

name: Spectral Rake
description: Flashes along the river's line so the foe sees the cut only after it has landed.

name: Dauntless Radiance Broadcurve
description: Gathers the whole field into one long curve and sends the school's signature cut through the guard.

name: Statute Crescent
description: Stands with the blade angled toward the far edge and the Core's light gathered in the chest.

name: Vigor Rake
description: Cuts the forehand with the Core's light running down the arm into the edge.

name: Squalllip
description: Steps toward the farthest point of the foe's reach and cuts as it arrives.

name: Whipcut Verdict
description: Turns the Core's pulse into the backhand so the cut comes harder than the arm alone could give.

name: Deluge Scimhilt
description: Parries across the line of sight and sends the foe's cut toward the horizon.

name: Inferno Scimhilt
description: Draws the edge in a long clear stroke with the Core's light spread along it.

name: Sigil Lop
description: Hooks the foe's weapon at the high line and the low line in a single pull.

name: Steel Flaretip
description: Holds a level line of qi across the front like the horizon and lets no blow pass it.

name: Peerless Crescent
description: Sends a crescent of Core-light from the blade to strike a foe at range.

name: Talwarvow
description: Raises two lines of qi on both horizons to hold against attacks from either side.

name: Retribution Saddleguard
description: Folds the whole line of the horizon to one point of the blade and cuts inward past any armour.

name: Matchless Cantle
description: Gathers the Core's light along the curve for the school's closing cut that reaches every foe in view.

name: Prismcantle
description: Faces the foe squarely and swears the guard with the blade held out across the front.

name: Vigorcantle
description: Cuts an overcut along the sworn line without letting the wrist stray from it.

name: Mighty Carve
description: Strides on flat ground with a long even step that never lifts the heel high.

name: Inviolate Flowedge
description: Turns the flat to the windward side and lets the foe's cut slide off into the draught.

name: Squall Swellback
description: Holds the blade on its sworn line through a hard parry and answers without moving it.

name: Bedrock Carve
description: Lifts a rising cut on a gust of qi that carries the edge to the foe's chin.

name: Colossal Scoop
description: Hooks the foe's wrist and holds it on the bearing until the oath cut lands.

name: Cantle Triumph
description: Draws the edge back along the foe's own cut and strikes the arm behind it.

name: Bedrock Arcwheel
description: Sweeps a wide arc that carries the cut's wind outward to every foe along its edge.

name: Steel Deepbelly
description: Stands in a ring of wind that rebuffs a rush of blows from the front.

name: Vacuumtalwar
description: Carries the sworn cut past the foe's guard in a single phase step and strikes behind it.

name: Lopverdict
description: Cuts the school's sworn curve in one stroke the student weighs to their strength and drives through a guard.

name: Interstice Broadcurve
description: Stands still and takes the foe's bearing from the angle of their shoulders and feet.

name: Talwaredict
description: Cuts the forehand along the bearing and holds the wrist level from start to end.

name: Dunerake
description: Retreats to the edge of the stance and no further so the foe overreaches.

name: Paritycantle
description: Shifts the blade a hand to one side of the bearing and turns the foe's cut from it.

name: Steel Whipcut
description: Draws the edge down a taken bearing with steady qi along its length.

name: Millstone Talwar
description: Hooks the foe's blade and holds it on the line while the counter lands.

name: Inferno Rake
description: Cuts beneath the foe's own bearing and strikes the leading knee.

name: Radiance Rake
description: Throws a line of qi along the taken bearing to strike a foe beyond sword reach.

name: Steeltalwar
description: Spreads qi flat along the ground and holds it as a low guard against sweeping cuts.

name: Interstice Carve
description: Flashes along the bearing past the foe's guard and cuts on the far side of it.

name: Vigor Whipcut
description: Holds a taken bearing through a slow gather of qi and lands the school's signature stroke along it.

name: Steel Cantle
description: Opens with the curve turned into the wind and the free hand held low behind it.

name: Thunderclap Talwar
description: Rolls the curve over the wrist and cuts down on the foe's raised hand.

name: Swellback Boon
description: Steps on a slant to the wind so the draught pushes the body into the cut.

name: Deluge Flowedge
description: Turns the curve against the foe's cut and sends it back along its own line.

name: Inferno Crescent
description: Pulls the edge across the target on a steady stream of qi from the wind's push.

name: Entropy Lop
description: Hooks the foe's sleeve in a gust and tears the guard arm open.

name: Lopedict
description: Cuts a rising curve that lifts the draught and cuts every foe in the swath.

name: Thunderous Deepbelly
description: Spins the curve to stir a ward of wind that deflects incoming steel.

name: Prism Scimhilt
description: Lets a blow pass into the curve and out again along the line it came from.

name: Choral Broadcurve Verdict
description: Closes the school's course in one long sworn curve the student paces to their own strength.

name: Prism Flaretip
description: Stands along the line of the gale with the blade held out and the stance low.

name: Steel Arcwheel
description: Cuts straight down the gale line from shoulder height to the hip.

name: Titan Saddleguard
description: Keeps both feet on the gale line through every shift of the fight.

name: Pall Broadcurve
description: Breaks the force of a cut on the flat so the gale carries it past.

name: Splendid Saddleguard
description: Draws the edge along the gale line with qi laid down the full length of the blade.

name: Squallcarve
description: Cuts across the gale line as the foe presses in and catches them midstep.

name: Swellback Seal
description: Hooks the foe's weapon and slides it down the gale line away from the body.

name: Peerless Flaretip
description: Turns the edge into the wind and braces the arm to hold against a heavy push.

name: Pealcantle
description: Throws the gale line forward from the blade as a narrow cutting stream of qi.

name: Statute Flowedge
description: Raises the line as a barrier of wind that holds as long as the stance does.

name: Arcwheel Solace
description: Flashes along the gale line faster than the foe's cut can follow.

name: Scooptriumph
description: Cuts the school's whole gale line into one stroke and drives it through a guard.

name: Sovereign Crescent
description: Opens in the open with the blade across the front and nothing behind the heels.

name: Haemaltalwar
description: Cuts level at the neck line and holds the arc to its sworn end.

name: Colossal Lop
description: Slides across open ground in a low line with the blade tracking the foe.

name: Parity Talwar
description: Holds the parry in the field and lets the foe's force bleed away along the curve.

name: Squallscoop
description: Draws the edge across the foe's open guard along a line sworn in advance.

name: Cantle Vow
description: Hooks a retreating foe and holds them to the oath's line.

name: Steel Scimhilt
description: Draws once into the foe's charge and strikes the leading arm as it comes.

name: Tempestuous Scoop
description: Cuts one wide sworn arc across the open that no nearby foe can step around.

name: Talwartroth
description: Holds the open ground without cover by a field that answers every strike with a counter.

name: Rakeboon
description: Passes the foe's guard by the strength of the oath and cuts from the far side.

name: Demolition Whipcut
description: Gathers the open field into the school's signature curve and cuts every foe in its reach.

name: Undaunted Scimhilt
description: Stands facing the farthest limit with the Core's light gathered in the chest.

name: Talwartriumph
description: Cuts an overcut with the Core's pulse driven down the arm and into the edge.

name: Squall Rake
description: Strides down the bearing in a long even pace that closes the gap smoothly.

name: Sainted Broadcurve
description: Parries early along the bearing so the foe's cut is turned before it arrives.

name: Quenched Lop
description: Draws the edge down the bearing with a stream of qi from the Core.

name: Lipseal
description: Hooks the foe's arm with the point extended by the field and pulls it to the bearing.

name: Valiant Scoop
description: Sends a line of Core-light across the plateau to strike a distant foe.

name: Cantleseal
description: Holds a barrier along the bearing that stops any blow crossing it.

name: Anima Carve
description: Folds the bearing into one point of the blade and cuts inward through the foe's armour.

name: Gallant Radiance Whipcut
description: Holds the bearing past the plateau and lands the school's closing cut beyond a guard.
